question: 论文用哪些具身任务检验模型能力？

gold_quotes.quote: Our three robot environments (Fig. 1) include a Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) domain where a robot has to manipulate (grasp and stack) objects, a table-top pushing environment, and a mobile manipulation domain.
For all domains we consider both planning and VQA tasks in those environments.

For the mobile manipulation and Language-Table environments, PaLM-E is integrated into the control loop to execute the plans in the real world, and has to adjust the plan in presence of external disturbances or failures of the low-level control policies.
